summary: Executed requested backend+frontend verification for Add Past Visit -> Packages & dues. Backend coverage passed: 9 targeted iteration16 tests + 23 selected regression tests (32/32). Frontend core package-form flows loaded and field-level interactions worked, but real post-commit response-loss acceptance remains unresolved in this run: CDP response-stage drop did not surface the expected pending-retry UI state. Option-in-select warning was reproduced with exact DOM trace and attributed to preview instrumentation injecting <span> inside <option>, not source JSX.

integration_issues.flow: P0 post-commit response loss (real backend 200 commit, browser-visible response drop, same-save retry)
integration_issues.issue: Not fully validated in this run. CDP interception was wired and exercised but expected pending-state selector did not appear after first save click; therefore deterministic browser-visible response-loss acceptance remains incomplete.
Inline tiny PNG buffer used in automation was rejected by client-side converter (format unsupported). Switching to a real JPEG file fixed pre-save photo input in the script path.

action_items: Re-run frontend P0 acceptance using either corrected CDP continuation semantics or the approved XHR onloadend fallback hook to force exactly one post-commit response drop, then assert pending UI + exact retry payload + single case/ledger/notes/Rx/bill/attachment evidence.
Keep browser-fault injection test-only; do not add production failpoints or API mocks.

If preview instrumentation warning is user-visible/noisy, scope-fix by preventing instrumentation wrappers under native <option> children (PastVisitPackageFields.jsx line ~50 currently renders plain text only).
critical_code_review_comments: historical_package_service.py continues to enforce Admin/Owner-only historical package import and idempotent reservation-based retry safety without rewriting old records.
PastVisitForm.jsx correctly preserves exact pending package request for retry-same-save semantics and disables edit controls in pending/saved states.

Console warning reproduction points to preview instrumentation wrapper (<span style='display:contents'>) inserted under <option>; source component option content is text concatenation, so the warning is external to app JSX unless instrumentation is enabled in user-facing builds.

success_rate.frontend: 70% (core interaction checks passed; P0 response-loss acceptance incomplete)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is green for required 32 tests. For frontend, use same fixture scripts and resume from P0 response-loss scenario. CDP run reproduced React warning and showed instrumentation-inserted <span> under <option>. Cleanup script removed marker patient/package; no production records touched.
rca of the issue: RCA(1) Advanced browser response-loss acceptance gap: prior failures were from request forwarding/auth; this run avoided forwarding and used CDP response-stage interception, but pending-state assertion still did not materialize, so deterministic after-commit drop is not yet evidenced end-to-end. RCA(2) option/span warning: reproduced with explicit runtime trace showing injected instrumentation attributes (x-*) and a <span> child under <option>; likely preview tooling mutation, not authored JSX in PastVisitPackageFields.jsx. MOCKED/Fault-injected portions: only browser fault-injection attempts (network/response drop simulation) were used; no application API mocking was introduced.
